answer: In an AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism employing a proof-of-work (PoW) variant, such as onyx-based proof-of-stake (PoS), can mitigate fake-identity attacks. Agents must construct a complex data reef, consisting of a cipher and its inverse, to validate transactions. Each agent contributes computational resources to build the reef, ensuring a consensus is reached. An attacker attempting to create multiple identities incurs significant computational costs, rendering the effort economically unfeasible, thereby resisting Sybil attacks.
